Name: Improved Butch Leah
Author: FadedRenn
Description:
Includes winter outfit, normal outfit and swimsuit so far. Also includes the blue suit for the flower dance,  tux for marriage, updated portraits and a short haircut! Work in progress as its my first mod but I am looking to add an updated spouse portrait as soon as possible! Please spread the word if you like it in case more people are interested in butch Leah.

Also if there is anyone else that people would like to see a butch mod for let me know in the comments of this mod! It was a lot of fun to make it and I would love to make another if people are interested!

Downloads.Description: Update for the Improved Butch Leah Mod! Now includes the appropriate flower dance outfit!
